Test-only pgvector WASM extension from `@electric-sql/pglite-pgvector` 0.0.9,
matching the existing PGlite 0.5.8 peer requirement. Copied verbatim dist/index.js,
dist/vector.tar.gz and LICENSE from the public npm tarball.
Tarball SHA-1: aa8dbc400517b2c09a58a6b216f0ce413430213b.
The two dist files are stored under runtime/ so the repository does not ignore them.
No npm dependency or lockfile changes. Apache-2.0 license included.
https://pglite.dev/extensions/ documents the extension API.
